你正在看的这个站The site you are looking at

零依赖的手写静态站：暗底海报的首页、图纸式第二视图、中英切换，全部由原生 HTML/CSS/ES module 完成，没有一个外部库。源码由一个零依赖的 Python 脚本组装，产物仍是可直接发布的静态文件。A hand-written static site with no dependencies: an ink-poster home page, a schematic second view and zh/en switching, all in native HTML, CSS and ES modules. The sources are assembled by a dependency-free Python script; the output is still plain static files you can publish as-is.
